report.summary: All 26 tests (API and UI) fail in the shared session fixture `base_url` before any test body runs. The Bookshelf app process exits with code 1 while starting, and the app's own traceback was not captured, so the cause is still unconfirmed. Run `python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000` with DB_PATH set in the same venv on the affected Windows machine to see the startup traceback first.

causes.title: Uvicorn app process exits during startup, so the session base_url fixture fails
causes.explanation: Every error is raised in tests/conftest.py:65 (`_wait_until_up`) during setup of the session-scoped `base_url` fixture. The child process started at conftest.py:59 (`python -m uvicorn app.main:app`) exits with return code 1 before it answers /health, so no test code runs. The app code itself looks valid: the module-level schema setup at app/main.py:57-58 and the routes are plain SQLite and FastAPI with nothing platform-specific. The run came from a Windows venv (C:\Users\IvanPosavec\Documents\qa-lab\.venv), which points to the environment rather than the code. Likely candidates are a missing or mismatched dependency in that venv (uvicorn, fastapi, jinja2 or python-multipart from requirements.txt), an older Python than the `str | None` syntax needs (3.10+), or a DB_PATH/APP_DB_PATH that cannot be created or opened. The app's stderr is inherited by pytest (conftest.py:58-62 does not capture it), so the traceback is missing from this report and that is the main gap in the evidence. Because the CI workflow runs on ubuntu-latest and this run was on Windows, the failure may be local to that machine.
evidence: RuntimeError: App exited early with code 1 (tests/conftest.py:35, raised from _wait_until_up at tests/conftest.py:65)
tests/conftest.py:58-62: subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-m", "uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--port", str(port), "--log-level", "warning"], cwd=ROOT, env=env) with no stdout/stderr capture
app/main.py:57-58: module-level `with db() as _conn: _conn.executescript(SCHEMA)` runs at import time, so any DB error kills the process at startup
requirements.txt lists fastapi, uvicorn, jinja2 and python-multipart; the failing run used the venv under C:\Users\IvanPosavec\Documents\qa-lab
causes.suggested_fix: Reproduce by running the same command as conftest.py:59 in the same venv, with DB_PATH pointed at a writable temp file, and read the traceback it prints. Then fix the environment: reinstall with `pip install -r requirements-dev.txt` into a Python 3.10+ venv, and make sure the DB path is writable. Also change conftest.py to pass stdout/stderr through (or capture them and include the tail in the RuntimeError) so the next failure shows the cause. Once the app starts, re-run the suite to confirm the 26 errors clear.
